description: This source file contains unit test classes and code for experimental features related to document section management in the MigraDoc library. It includes definitions for Paragraphs, Sections, Document, and related interfaces and implementations for creating and manipulating document sections and paragraphs, along with a test method demonstrating usage.

classes.name: Paragraph
classes.description: Represents a text paragraph in a document, supporting adding text and new lines.

classes.name: ISectionInterface<T>
classes.description: Generic interface for section-like structures with paragraph collection support.

classes.name: SectionCreatorImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the section interface that adds sections to a document.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Represents a section in a document, containing multiple paragraphs.

classes.name: LastSectionAccessor
classes.description: Utility class to access the last section of a document, creating one if it doesn't exist.

classes.name: Document
classes.description: Represents a document with a collection of sections and methods to add and serialize sections.

classes.name: DocumentApp
classes.description: Test class demonstrating the usage of the Document's last section and paragraph management.

methods.name: AddText
methods.description: Appends text to the paragraph's content.

methods.name: AddNewLine
methods.description: Adds a newline to the paragraph's content.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns string representation of paragraph or section.

methods.name: AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a paragraph to a section.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the last section, creating one if none exists.

methods.name: AddSection
methods.description: Adds a section to the document.

methods.name: TestMain
methods.description: Main test method demonstrating document and section usage.
